limitations: Three repeated six-task suites do not establish general developer seniority or statistical causality.
Shared host; agents chose different algorithms and Kujo versions. Language-speed ratios are not interchangeable across cases.
Raw runner summary drops metadata when its deadline aborts before terminal SSE; figures here use durable execution usage, including the cancelled case.
Usage is model-reported repeated input/output tokens, not unique context or a monetary bill.
Quality probes are supplementary; original acceptance gates unchanged. Saved source correctness does not turn the timed-out case into a pass.
